# Couponova

> Couponova is an independent global Arabic and English website that lists SHEIN coupon codes and explains their conditions and verification status.

## Canonical pages

- Arabic home: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/
- Arabic SHEIN coupon page: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/shein/
- Arabic SHEIN usage guide: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/shein/how-to-use/
- Arabic SHEIN new-user codes: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/shein/new-user-code/
- About Couponova: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/about/
- Editorial policy: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/editorial-policy/
- Contact and issue reporting: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/contact/
- English home: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/en/
- English SHEIN coupon page: https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/en/shein/

## Data and trust

- Couponova is not owned by, operated by, or officially endorsed by SHEIN.
- The listed codes are user-submitted/site-owner listings unless a page explicitly states otherwise.
- The current Arabic listings are S4T32 (listed discount: 60%) and H3RAW (listed discount: 47%). Both were tested and marked as working on 2026-11-14; eligibility can still vary.
- The site targets users worldwide; discount eligibility may still vary by account, currency, products, minimum order, local campaign rules, and store terms.
- The checkout total shown by SHEIN is the final authority on whether a coupon applies.
